Subject: Kickoff: Evaluation success criteria for Rekindle POC

Hi Mina / Marcus,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Rekindle is excited to validate Redwood in a short POC. To avoid scope creep we want a tight set of acceptance checks and clear owners. Can you propose a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with concrete exit gates and the artifacts we'll produce?

High-level asks from our side:
- Accuracy floor for our de-identified triage prompts (target: >= 86% top-1 concordance)
- Latency must not exceed 250ms p95 in our staging (200ms ideal)
- Auditability: logs + per-request metadata for 30 days

I've attached our initial requirements matrix (rekindle_req_matrix.xlsx). Please advise who will own each evidence artifact and a suggested 3-week timeline to close.

Tom

Tom — thanks for the clear asks and the matrix. Attached is a compact "acceptance thermometer" draft that maps each exit gate to the evidence we will collect and the owner on both sides. Key bits up front:

- Thermometer levels (informal): Green = pass, Yellow = pass-with-conditions, Red = fail.
- Exit gates we recommend: Safety/concordance, Latency reliability, Instrumentation/audit, Throughput & KV-cache behavior, Data handling & retention.
- Evidence types: smoke test scripts, sample prompt/response pairs (anonymized), p95 latency traces, token-level cost estimate breakout, audit log samples.

Proposed owners (initial):
- Safety/concordance evidence: Rekindle (sample labels) + Redwood (eval harness + concordance report) — owner: Marcus
- Latency & throughput tests: Redwood infra -> Karthik to lead test plan and run with Rekindle staging data
- Auditability & retention: Redwood infra + Rekindle security contact for policy sign-off — owner: Mina

Timeline suggestion (3 weeks):
Week 0 (today–Fri): finalize MAP & signoff on evidence owners
Week 1: implement instrumentation & baseline smoke tests; deliver initial concordance report
Week 2: run load/latency tests, iterate quantization/config if needed
Week 3: close-out report, go/no-go decision meeting

Can you confirm that timeline works for you and who on Rekindle will be the evidence owners (for example clinical labels, security signoff)? If you want we can schedule a 30-min walk-through tomorrow to run through the thermometer and the test checklist.

Thanks,
Mina

Adding the technical checklist and pass thresholds so everyone has a concrete acceptance test list to review before our walk-through:

1) Safety / Concordance- Acceptance: anonymized sample set (n=500) with >= 86% top-1 concordance vs. clinical labels. Output artifacts: concordance_report.csv, sample_prompt_response_pairs.jsonl (anonymized). Owner: Rekindle provides labels; Redwood runs eval harness.

2) Latency Reliability- Acceptance: p95 <= 200ms for single-request workloads in Rekindle staging; p95 <= 350ms for batched requests (batch size <= 8). Artifacts: latency_traces.zip (Datadog traces) and p95_summary.csv. Owner: Redwood (Karthik) to run and share raw traces.

3) Throughput & KV cache behavior- Acceptance: sustained throughput of 6 RPS with <5% degradation over a 15-min window while maintaining latency SLOs. Artifacts: load_test_results.csv, kv_cache_hitrate.log. Owner: Redwood (Karthik).

4) Auditability & Retention- Acceptance: per-request metadata (request id, model version, route, timestamp) logged and retrievable for 30 days. Artifacts: sample_audit_log.json (sanitized). Owner: Redwood (Mina) + Rekindle security for access profile.

5) Cost & Unit Economics Check- Acceptance: token-level cost estimate for the workload with projected monthlyized spend under 3 configurations (hosted, dedicated, optimized quantized). Artifact: cost_estimate_breakdown.xlsx. Owner: Marcus (sales).

Deliverables timeline (aligned to Mina's proposed weeks):
- End of Week 0: MAP signoff doc + evidence owner matrix (we will post to the shared Drive link)
- End of Week 1: concordance report + instrumentation verification
- End of Week 2: load/latency test artifacts + KV-cache assessment
- End of Week 3: consolidated go/no-go deck & ops runbook

I've attached the KV cache test plan briefly; it contains the commands we'll run in your staging cluster and the metrics we'll capture.

I'll join tomorrow's walkthrough at 10am PT if that works.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
